function: Learned semantic-aware downlink multi-user massive MIMO beamforming at an airship base station, trained end to end with semantic image coding and decoding (pp. 3, 6).
system: Airship BS with 8x8 UPA (64 antennas), 4 single-antenna UEs, OFDM with 64 subcarriers, 2 paths per UE; no RIS; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 9).
method: End-to-end deep learning: Swin Transformer image codec, transformer CSI extraction and fusion, hybrid data-driven and unfolded-WMMSE beamforming; MSE, MS-SSIM, LPIPS loss; image networks pre-trained (pp. 4-10).
data_channel: Custom sparse multipath simulator, i.i.d. complex Gaussian path gains, CSI estimated by GMMV-LAMP; ImageNet images, 100000 training and 10000 test; no standard or measured channel (p. 9).
test_conditions: Same simulated channel and ImageNet split for training and testing; evaluation sweeps pilot symbols, SNR, and transmitted symbols; training conditions of each sweep are not stated (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: BPG + LDPC + QAM + RZF. Learned: bmshj2018 + LDPC + QAM + RZF, BPG/bmshj2018 + E2E transmission network, CNN deep JSCC; capacity bounds; ablation (pp. 9, 12).
metrics: PSNR, MS-SSIM, LPIPS versus pilot OFDM symbols, SNR, and transmitted symbols Q; CDFs and visual examples; NMSE of the channel estimator (pp. 9-12).
q1_support: p. 9: "The channel dataset is generated following the sparse multipath"; custom airship simulator with i.i.d. Gaussian path gains; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "over different numbers of pilot OFDM"; only sweeps over pilots, SNR, and Q; no unseen scenario, band, dataset, or number of users or antennas is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "BPG/bmshj2018 + LDPC + QAM + RZF" (non-learned); "Deep JSCC: In this case, we adopt the CNN-based deep" (earlier learned method); also an E2E transmission network baseline.
q4_support: p. 4: "while reducing computational complexity compared to global"; only a qualitative remark on Swin attention; no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count, or runtime of the proposed networks is reported.
q5_support: p. 9: "we adopt the open-source ImageNet"; a public image dataset of the task only, the channel is simulated, and no code or data link is given.
notes: Area 6 versus 3: the learned method is downlink beamforming (an area 3 function) for an airship-borne BS, which is an aerial link, so the order rule gives 6; the reviewer may prefer 3, since the method and channel are generic massive MIMO.
